title: The Rain, 2025
logline: The twenty-eighth January. The garage sill, the three jars, the sand dollar, rain — and this year the bird on the sill outside, and the pup asleep inside, and the two of them separated by the glass and drawn the same size.

panels.composition: The casement window in January rain from inside: three jars and the sand dollar on the sill, and through the glass on the outer sill the rainbow bird, and below the window in the bed the pup asleep — the bird and the dog drawn the same size, the glass between them.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage window in January rain from inside with three jars and a sand dollar on the sill, a small rainbow bird on the outer sill through the glass, and a small three-legged dog asleep in a bed below, the bird and dog drawn the same size, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The Rain with the bird outside and the dog inside, the same size.
